channel.title: Tax News & Insights | LEE EUNSANG TAX
channel.description: Key IRS and California tax updates, explained by Eunsang Lee, EA, an Enrolled Agent in Brea, CA.

item.title: 2026 Tax Return Checklist: Documents to Gather, Direct Deposit, IP PIN and ITIN Expiration
item.description: What to do now before filing your 2026 return in spring 2027, based on IRS guidance: documents to gather, your IRS online account, direct deposit, IP PIN, ITIN expiration and refund timing, explained by an Enrolled Agent in Brea, CA.

item.title: IRS Announces 2027 Inflation Adjustments: Standard Deduction, Tax Brackets and Child Tax Credit
item.description: The IRS released its tax year 2027 inflation adjustments. Standard deduction, tax brackets, Child Tax Credit and gift exclusion amounts as announced, and what to review now, explained by an Enrolled Agent in Brea, CA.

item.title: Four New Federal Deductions: Tips, Overtime, Car Loan Interest and the $6,000 Senior Deduction. What to Check Before Year-End
item.description: The four new federal deductions for 2025 through 2028 are available even if you take the standard deduction, but the rules are strict. Amounts, income limits, common requirements and year-end checks, explained by an Enrolled Agent in Brea, CA.

item.title: Year-End Tax Planning for Business Owners: Equipment, Vehicles, 100% Bonus Depreciation and Section 179 (2026)
item.description: If you plan to buy business equipment or a vehicle, placing it in service by December 31 decides whether you deduct it this year. 2026 Section 179 limits, permanent 100% bonus depreciation, and how California differs, explained by an Enrolled Agent in Brea, CA.

item.title: Charitable Deduction Without Itemizing Starting 2026: Up to $1,000 ($2,000 for Couples)
item.description: Starting in 2026, taxpayers who take the standard deduction can deduct up to $1,000 ($2,000 married filing jointly) of cash gifts to churches and charities. Who qualifies, what counts, and how to keep records, explained by an Enrolled Agent in Brea, CA.
